description: Tax on equity compensation: income tax, social security and employer withholding when RSUs vest or stock options are exercised, and capital gains tax on a later sale (give sale_price and sale_date), with flags (such as AMT exposure) and the alternative outcomes the law allows (such as qualifying vs disqualifying disposition). Countries and instruments: us (rsu, nso, iso), uk (rsu, emi, csop, unapproved_option), au (ess_upfront, ess_deferred, rsu), ca (stock_option), in (esop, rsu). Required: country, instrument, units, grant_date, event_date, fmv_event, gross_salary; options also need exercise_price. region is REQUIRED for: ca; optional for: us, uk. Other countries return the list of supported ones. Returns the tax year, official source URLs and the calcbloc.com page. Not yet supported: cross-border salary withholding (multi-country payroll), and the double-tax relief amount (get_tax_treaties lists the treaty withholding limits CalcBloc stores).

country.description: Country short code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in lower case; the UK is "uk", "gb" also works), e.g. "us", "uk", "ca", "de", "in", "au", "nz", or the English name. Older keys such as "new-zealand" also work. See list_countries.

event_date.description: Vest date (RSUs), exercise date (options), or the acquisition or deferred taxing point (Australia ESS) (YYYY-MM-DD).

exercise_price.description: Exercise price per share (required for options; RSUs: any amount paid, default 0).

fmv_event.description: Market value per share at vest or exercise, in the country's currency (India: FMV under rule 15(6)).

fmv_grant.description: Market value per share at grant (UK EMI discount and CSOP limit, Canada 110(1)(d) and the vesting limit).

gross_salary.description: Regular annual gross salary in the country's currency (for the marginal rates and contribution ceilings).

instrument.description: Equity instrument; each country has its own: us (rsu, nso, iso), uk (rsu, emi, csop, unapproved_option), au (ess_upfront, ess_deferred, rsu), ca (stock_option), in (esop, rsu).

options.description: Country-specific options. Examples: US {"filing_status":"mfj"}, UK {"readily_convertible":false,"emi_exercise_period_years":"10"}, Canada {"employer_type":"ccpc"}, India {"regime":"old","listed":true}. Call list_countries with the country to see every option, its allowed values and its default.

region.description: Region code or name. Required for: ca; optional for: us, uk. Examples: Canada "on" or "Ontario", US "ca" (state withholding; omit for federal only), UK "scotland".

sale_price.description: Sale price per share; with sale_date it adds the tax on the sale.

units.description: Number of shares vesting or options exercised.
